events.comment: GDevelop Open Game - 3D city sandbox. Walk around, steal cars (E), and collect all the cash. Assets: Kenney (CC0).

inlineCode: // Pointer lock mouse look: click the game to capture the mouse, Esc to release.

events.comment: Only one car can be driven at a time: the one whose "Driven" variable is true.
Swing the camera behind the car while it moves.
Leave the car: the player is recreated next to the driver door.
Parked cars keep their handbrake on.
Enter the nearest building or car.
Each door always opens the same interior: its Layout and HouseId are set on the DoorZone instance.
Blasters: walk over one to pick it up (it swaps with the one you hold). Hold the left mouse button to shoot.
Pick up the nearest blaster; the one in hand is dropped where the new one was.
Aiming: while shooting the player faces the camera direction and strafes with WASD.
Over-the-shoulder camera while armed, so the blaster isn't hidden behind the head.

inlineCode: // Keep the held blaster in the player's right hand (the "arm-right" bone of the Kenney character)
// and remember the muzzle position for the shooting events.
x = hand.x; y = hand.y; z = hand.z;

events.comment: Third-person orbit camera around Target (the player or the driven car).
Pedestrians hit by a fast car fall over.
